transitions.action: dispatch one R16 task bound to exact trigger_event_id
after R16 delivery accepted/rejected, record consumed_at
archive event fields; if successful periodic strategy review reset since_last=0

hard_rules: same trigger_event_id cannot be dispatched twice
EVERY_10_CONTENT_LOCKS uses counter threshold, not chat memory
R16 cannot create/consume/reset its own trigger event
R16 periodic counters are driven only by actual PUBLISHED events, never by CONTENT LOCK creation.

published_count_idempotency.create_when: Only after R01 confirms PASS/PUBLISHED from a valid R14 publish receipt.
published_count_idempotency.increment_rule: If PUBLISHED::{content_id} is absent, record one immutable event and increment published_content_count_total and published_content_count_since_last_strategy_review by 1.
published_count_idempotency.duplicate_rule: If already present, delta=0. CONTENT LOCK creation/re-lock, publish-package rebuild, or compliance reauthorization never increments.
